```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(reactable)


phd <- read_csv("phd.csv")
msc <- read_csv("msc.csv")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
num_phd <- nrow(phd)
num_msc <- nrow(msc)
num_phd_grad <- sum(phd$status == "Graduated", na.rm = TRUE)
num_msc_grad <- sum(msc$status == "Graduated", na.rm = TRUE)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Supervision Overview

I have supervised **`r nrow(phd)`** PhD students (**`r num_phd_grad`** graduated) and  **`r nrow(msc)`** MSc theses (**`r num_msc_grad`** graduated).  

Graduates are currently working in academia, industry, and the public sector.
:::



## PhD Supervision

```{r}
library(reactable)

reactable(
phd |>
arrange(desc(graduation_year)) |>
select(
name,
thesis_title,
graduation_year,
current_position,
link
),
searchable = TRUE,
compact = TRUE,
striped = TRUE,
highlight = TRUE,
bordered = FALSE,
defaultSorted = "graduation_year",
defaultSortOrder = "desc",
rowStyle = function(index) {
if (is.na(phd$graduation_year[index])) {
list(fontStyle = "italic", background = "#fafafa")
}
},
columns = list(
name = colDef(
name = "Name",
style = list(fontWeight = 500)
),
thesis_title = colDef(
name = "PhD Title",
minWidth = 360,
style = list(color = "#444", verticalAlign = "top")
),
graduation_year = colDef(
name = "Year",
align = "center",
width = 70,
style = list(color = "#777")
),
current_position = colDef(
name = "Current Position",
minWidth = 280,
style = list(verticalAlign = "top")
),
link = colDef(
name = "Link",
align = "center",
width = 50,
cell = function(value) {
if (is.na(value) || value == "") "" else {
htmltools::a("↗", href = value, target = "_blank")
}
}
)
)
)


```


## MSc Supervision

```{r}
reactable(
  msc |>
    arrange(desc(graduation_year)) |>
    select(
      name,
      thesis_title,
      graduation_year,
      current_position,
      link
    ),
  searchable = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,
  defaultSorted = "graduation_year",
  defaultSortOrder = "desc",
  rowStyle = function(index) {
    if (is.na(msc$graduation_year[index])) {
      list(fontStyle = "italic", background = "#fafafa")
    }
  },
  columns = list(
    name = colDef(
      name = "Name",
      style = list(fontWeight = 500)
    ),
    thesis_title = colDef(
      name = "MSc Title",
      minWidth = 320,
      style = list(color = "#444", verticalAlign = "top")
    ),
    graduation_year = colDef(
      name = "Year",
      align = "center",
      width = 70,
      style = list(color = "#777")
    ),
    current_position = colDef(
      name = "Current Position",
      minWidth = 260,
      style = list(verticalAlign = "top")
    ),
    link = colDef(
      name = "Link",
      align = "center",
      width = 50,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value) || value == "") "" else {
          htmltools::a("↗", href = value, target = "_blank")
        }
      }
    )
  )
)

```
